description: Pay for a bounty that waits for payment. x402 (USDC on Base): put the x402 payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (or the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE HTTP header); without one, method x402 returns the payment terms as an error result with structuredContent (the x402 MCP transport; it also lists payment_methods and mpp_challenges), and a paid result carries _meta["x402/payment-response"]. The ways below are taken only when that unpaid result lists them (mpp_challenges, payment_methods). MPP (Stripe charge method): answer one of mpp_challenges with _meta["org.paymentauth/credential"] = { challenge, payload: { spt } }; a client that declared capabilities.experimental.payment at initialize gets the challenges as JSON-RPC error -32042 (-32043 when a credential did not verify), and a paid result carries _meta["org.paymentauth/receipt"]. spt: a Stripe shared payment token (spt_...) for the amount, charged once (cards, Link and card-network agent tokens arrive this way). skyfire_token: a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token for at least the amount. A payment by MPP, spt or Skyfire lands in the paying key's balance and pays the bounty from it, outside the key's spending limits; with no agent_key a key is made for the payer and returned once (the same proof again shows it within 24 hours). method balance pays from agent_key's balance within its spending limits. method card (or no way to pay) returns the pay link to show a person; a client that declared URL elicitation receives it as a -32042 URL elicitation and retries after the person pays. pay_token from bounty_post lets any payer pay; without it only the posting agent's key can. expected_amount_usd is the amount you saw: when the bounty's amount is different now (its poster raised it) the result is code amount_changed with the new amount_usd and nothing is paid. Every result that did not pay (refused, unavailable, closed, or waiting for a person on pay_url) is an error result with the details in structuredContent. A retried payment (same authorization or payment-identifier id) returns its first outcome.

agent_key.description: The paying agent's key (balance), or the posting agent's key.

expected_amount_usd.description: The amount you saw; a different amount due now is refused and nothing is paid. Needed when paying someone else's bounty with its pay token from balance, spt or skyfire_token.

method.description: Omit: the attached payment decides (MPP credential, spt, skyfire_token, x402), else balance with agent_key, else card.

pay_token.description: The pay_token from bounty_post or bounty_pay_link.

skyfire_token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token (what the kyapay-token header carries).

spt.description: A Stripe shared payment token for this amount.
